source_notes.label: Filtered input river-water characterization
source_notes.summary: The filtered input river water contained less than 0.1 ppb total mercury by ICPMS (Agilent 7500ce), measured before mixing with the DNA/QD buffer (main PDF p. 4). This is input-water characterization, not the final sensing-ensemble background.
